title: Preserve include/exclude filters when function serializer falls back
answers: Why does model_dump(include=...) or model_dump(exclude=...) not work with model_serializer(when_used='json')?
How to prevent include and exclude from being dropped when a custom serializer falls back?
model_dump ignores exclude or include parameters when when_used condition is not met
body:
Symptom: Calling model_dump() with include or exclude ignores the filters when a model has a model_serializer configured with when_used='json'.
Root cause: pydantic-core/src/serializers/type_serializers/function.rs:function_type_serializer cleared include/exclude unconditionally, dropping user filters even when the serializer was skipped and fallback was called.
Fix pattern: Check whether the serializer function executed or fell back; clear include/exclude only when the function executed, and preserve state.include_exclude() on fallback.
Constraints: Applies to function serializers with fallback logic; when the custom function actually executes, include/exclude must still be cleared because the function handles its own filtering.
applies: Function-based serializers in pydantic-core with fallback serializers such as when_used conditions.
